statements.t: We expect that our capital spending requirements will continue to be financed primarily through internally generated funds.

While we may be exposed to credit losses due to the nonperformance of our counterparties, we consider the risk remote and do not expect that any such nonperformance would result in a significant effect on our results of operations or financial condition due to our diversified pool of counterparties.
We enter into interest rate swaps to achieve a targeted mix of fixed and variable rate debt.

On September 14, 2026, Verizon entered into definitive agreements with AT&T Inc. and T-Mobile US, Inc., or their wholly owned subsidiaries, as applicable, to form a joint venture which aims to end wireless dead zones in the U.S. and expand satellite coverage for customers nationwide.
We expect to license certain intellectual property to the joint venture, and to provide access to certain spectrum licenses to satellite providers who contract with the joint venture.

dropped.t: On May 14, 2026, Verizon entered into an agreement in principle with AT&T Inc. and T-Mobile US, Inc., to form a new joint venture which aims to help end wireless dead zones in the U.S., including in rural areas, by pooling limited spectrum resources to increase capacity, improve the customer experience, and help satellite providers reach more customers through a unified platform.
For the full year 2026, our share repurchase target has been increased from $3.0 billion to up to $4.5 billion.
